subject: Sean Whalen, poet near Pilot Mound, Iowa

policy.repositoryStorage: No third-party image binaries are stored in this repository.
policy.websiteUse: Reference only until Sean supplies or approves a source file and confirms photographer credit and web-use rights.
policy.privacy: Do not identify people in unlabeled group photographs by visual guesswork.

portraitSources.description: Professional vertical studio headshot on Sean's Thimble Literary Magazine author page. It is the strongest website portrait lead located.
portraitSources.visualNotes: Neutral dark studio background, professional lighting, vertical composition, and enough source resolution for responsive website crops. The published file is visibly watermarked.
portraitSources.whyMatched: The author page says Sean lives near Pilot Mound and links his poem The Disinfectant Girl.
portraitSources.rightsStatus: not cleared; the watermark and copyright metadata make permission especially important
portraitSources.recommendedAction: Ask Sean and Stacy McDonald for the unwatermarked original plus written permission for website, social-card, press, cropping, and responsive-resizing use. Confirm the exact credit line. Do not crop out the watermark from the published copy.

portraitSources.description: Casual photograph of Sean with a cat, displayed at the top of his first-person Gyroscope Review Poet Pick.
portraitSources.visualNotes: The cat fills much of the foreground and partly obscures Sean. The image is suitable as a personal About-page reference but is too small and compositionally weak for a main website hero.
portraitSources.whyMatched: The image is embedded in a named first-person profile whose bio contains the full Pilot Mound identity fingerprint.
portraitSources.rightsStatus: unknown; visible online is not permission to reuse
portraitSources.recommendedAction: If Sean likes this image, ask for its original file, photographer name, required credit, crop permission, and explicit web/social usage permission.

portraitSources.description: Small outdoor portrait shown beside Sean's identity-rich contributor biography. The same apparent source photo is repeated in Founder's Favourites 22 and Halcyon Days 29.

sourceAssets.location: bottom-left contributor block on the p. 12–13 spread

portraitSources.whyMatched: Both placements pair the portrait with a uniquely matching Iowa, Iowa State, health-and-safety, and publication-history biography.
portraitSources.rightsStatus: unknown; the page scans also contain copyrighted poems and third-party design assets
portraitSources.recommendedAction: Request the uncropped original from Sean instead of extracting the low-resolution image from a magazine scan.

reviewedButNotUsable.source: Pilot Mound municipal and fire-department pages
reviewedButNotUsable.reason: Group photographs are not captioned at the person level, so Sean cannot be identified safely from them. They also lack an explicit reuse license.

reviewedButNotUsable.source: Search results for other people named Sean Whalen
reviewedButNotUsable.reason: Actor, entrepreneur, scientist, artist, clinician, musician, and other same-name portraits fail the Pilot Mound identity test.

commissioningChecklist: current author headshot in vertical and horizontal crops
full-resolution original rather than a social-media or publication scrape
photographer name and exact credit line
written permission for website, social sharing cards, press use, cropping, and responsive resizing
optional permission-cleared environmental portrait near home or a public rural Boone County location
optional detail images of maps, land, weather, field textures, or fire-service objects without private-location disclosure
